links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-generated spine care answers versus requested reading level
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid grade levels were consistently higher than target levels (e.g., PreK-3rd prompts averaged FK 7.3; 8th-12th prompts averaged 13.4); FRE scores 73.7 to 4.1 across levels.
links.quote: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores, however, were consistently higher than the target levels ChatGPT was instructed to emulate ( Table 2 ).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient materials relative to recommended 5th-6th grade level
links.effect: ChatGPT output exceeded intended reading levels; only 22.1% chose 8th-12th grade and 50.6% chose postgraduate-level text; authors recommend targeting 8th-12th grade or lower, above AMA 5th-6th grade guidance.
links.quote: Similar to previous work, we found that ChatGPT often generates content above the intended reading level.
